config.description: Project UUID the key belongs to. Optional for single-project account keys.

config.description: Override the API base URL (self-hosted deployments). Defaults to the hosted Mushi Cloud endpoint.

config.description: Comma-separated feature groups to expose (triage,fixes,inventory,setup,docs). Defaults to the lean catalog; use 'all' for the full tool set.
